[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Martha Jones Glasgow was born about 1753, daughter of Col. James Glasgow (1740-1790).  <ref name=Martha>http://files.usgwarchives.net/tx/bexar/military/alamo/alamo.txt</ref>Parents were Rev. James Patrick Glasgow and Martha Jones daughter of Thomas and Mary Wilson Jones of Cecil county, Maryland. She is the sister of Gov. James Glasgow.

'''Marriage 1''' <br>
Martha  married Benjamin Sheppard (1751 – 1798)  Martha died 6 of July 1818, Chatham Co., N.C. 

The case below shows many family interactions but these excerpts from it show that 1. Martha was married to Benjamin at the time of his death; and 2. that she and her brother, James Glasgow, were the administratix and administrator of Benjamin's estate; and 3. that Martha married Joseph Scurlock.

*http://www.speightfamily.net/data/n_63a.htm
"From N.C. Supreme Court Original Cases, Case #79, SHEPPARD vs. 
GLASGOW, 1814

N.C., Greene County - Equity Docket, Oct. term 1814
JAMES G. SHEPPARD & Others vs JAMES GLASGOW & Others. Original Bill
1811.

Your orators, JAMES GLASGOW SHEPPARD, BENJAMIN C.D.B. SHEPPARD, &
ABRAM SHEPPARD, infants, by their guardian, the said James G. Sheppard,
show that BENJAMIN SHEPPARD your orators father died intestate some
time in or about the month of October 1798 possessed of a very large
real & personal estate. That administration of his estate was granted
to JAMES GLASGOW and MARTHA JONES SHEPPARD, his widow, who entered into
bond with WILLIAM SPEIGHT & MARTIN G. SHEPPARD their securities for the
faithful administration of the estate."<br>
and<br>
"Your orators further shew that the sd MARTHA administratrix 
intermarried with JOSEPH SCURLOCK & the said JAMES & JOSEPH & MARTHA
adminstrators greatly mismanaged the estate by making improper sales
thereof & by suffering judgments agst the estate when nothing was really
due."

'''Marriage 2''' <br>
She married (secondly) Joseph Scurlock 13 July 1800 in Greene County, North Carolina.<ref name=Martha />  Joseph Scurlock married Martha Jones (Glasgow), a widow of Col. Benjamin Sheppard, July 13, 1800, in Green County, North  Carolina. 
Abstracts of North Carolina marriages
*"Scurlock, Joseph of Chatham county to Mrs. Martha J. Sheppard of Greene county, Jly. 13, Greene county. R. R. Aug. 5, 1800

Shepard, Mrs. Martha J. of Greene county to Joseph Scurlock of Chatham county, Jly. 13, Greene county. R. R. Aug. 5, 1800"

Children: 4 

1) William Scurlock (1807 - 1877) <ref name=Martha />William Scurlock was an early settler and involved in the Texas Revolution. He was the brother of Mial Scurlock that died in the Alamo on March 6, 1836.

2) Mial Scurlock, Alamo Defender (Chatham County, North Carolina, on May 25, 1809  - Mar 6,1836) killed in the Alamo, Texas Colony <ref name=Martha /><ref>https://www.thealamo.org/remember/battle-and-revolution/defenders/mial-scurlock#fromDefendersList</ref>

She passed away July 6, 1818 in Pittsboro, Chatham, North Carolina.
